newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy September delivery kerosene.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy September delivery kerosene.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy superior kerosene for delivery in September, industry sources said on Wednesday.
The tender seeks 40,000-45,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender closes on August 7 and offers will be valid until August 8.
In its tender for August deliveries, IOC purchased one cargo from Mobil at three cents per barrel over spot Singapore quotes on a c-and-f basis.
